description: Authoritative field map for Conan Exiles Enhanced server config editing in Pelican.

credits.name: balnaimi/conan-exiles-server
credits.role: Settings categories, env-oriented operator map, and INI key coverage used as requirements source (independent reimplementation).

credits.name: palworld-settings-editor
credits.role: Pelican plugin safe-edit patterns (not schema content).

pve-c.label: PvE-Conflict
pve-c.description: Player combat allowed; bases not raidable. Requires PVPEnabled=True and CombatModeModifier=1.

fields.label: Creative mode server
fields.help: Enables creative-mode server behaviour. Usually 0 for normal play.

fields.label: Admin password
fields.help: Password for in-game admin (MakeMeAdmin <password>). Keep private; not the join password.

fields.label: Event Log PvE Causer Privacy
fields.help: Event-log privacy for PvE damage causers. Higher = more private.

fields.label: Event Log PvP Causer Privacy
fields.help: Event-log privacy for PvP damage causers. Higher = more private.

fields.label: BattlEye anti-cheat
fields.help: Enable BattlEye anti-cheat. Recommended for public servers.

fields.label: VAC anti-cheat
fields.help: Enable Valve Anti-Cheat where supported.

fields.label: Max Nudity
fields.help: Maximum allowed character nudity level (0–2).

fields.label: List as community server
fields.help: When enabled, marks the server as a community server in listings (where supported).

fields.label: Server description (MOTD)
fields.help: Message of the day when players connect. Closest thing to a public server description in Conan.

fields.label: Join password
fields.help: Password required to join from the multiplayer browser. Empty = public. On this egg, startup also uses SRV_PW — keep both consistent.

fields.label: Server region
fields.help: Matchmaking/list region for the server browser. Wrong region can hide the server from players.

fields.label: Allowed Distance Undermesh Squared
fields.help: Squared distance threshold for undermesh detection

fields.label: Allowed Time Undermesh
fields.help: Seconds allowed undermesh before action. -1 often disables timer.

fields.help: Allow family shared Steam accounts to join (True/False)

fields.help: Detect players under the world mesh.
